lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Listen to them. The whole square is full — and they're terrified, and they're furious, and they don't know which one they are yet.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Breeze's emergency vial. Brass and zinc. Kelsier, if you're watching: this is the part you'd have enjoyed.

lines.speaker: The Lord Ruler
lines.text: Do not presume to speak to my people.
